Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely identified “Muscle Headz Gym (200 Main St)” and “Pleasant Valley Wellness Center (2520 Valley Dr)” as the target gyms without verifying their existence, exact addresses, or “by car” distances. Subsequent steps only entered queries into tools without capturing any results, yet WebSurfer later asserted Google Maps confirmations and distances (0.3 mi and ~2.0 mi) without evidence. This unverified assumption at step 8 led to an unsupported and likely incorrect/incomplete final answer.
